2610.13794.title: Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models
2610.13794.paper_summary: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.
2610.13794.paper_summary_zh: 話語粒子微妙地塑造了話語的流動，通過反映對話背景和對話者的態度，通常不改變其真值條件意義。它們通常也是多功能的，具有與其他粒子部分重疊的不同意義；例如，英語中的“just”和“only”的獨特用法（“John only/just drinks water”）。儘管這些詞在自然語言中頻繁出現，但由於其影響的微妙性，它們在很大程度上未受到研究。我們通過行為和機制分析研究 LLM 對自然對話中“just”和“only”的敏感性。首先，我們發現 LLM 和人類在上下文中同樣偏好這些粒子的存在，並且兩者對“just”的敏感性高於“only”。其次，當從有和沒有這些粒子的 LLM 中進行抽樣時，我們發現 LLM 在給定其源上下文的情況下，始終將生成的內容評價為更可能，顯示出它們對粒子的敏感性。在這兩個實驗中，指令調整增加了敏感性。最後，我們在 LLM 中定位了對粒子敏感的單元，並發現“just”和“only”之間的重疊是不對稱的：“only”單元選擇性地轉移到獨佔的“just”，而所有“just”單元則無論意義如何都能同樣好地轉移到“only”，這表明 LLM 的詞彙級粒子表示部分是按意義組織的。我們在 https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation 上發布了我們的代碼、標註意義的對話刺激和人類偏好註釋。
